6:bulkley-river:bulkley-river-and-morice.why: Owner 11-09: the Forks zone is THREE arms — 100 m up the Morice, 100 m up the upper Bulkley, ~1 km down the Bulkley. FWA: below the confluence the water is the BULKLEY (blk 360873822, gnis 2195); the Morice (gnis 14918) ends at the confluence. Each place binds its own water's arms: this Bulkley place = 100 m up the upper Bulkley (360873822:164908) + the 1 km below (360873822:163908), both existing cuts; the Morice place holds the Morice's 100 m. Tributaries excluded.

6:morice-river:bulkley-river-and-morice-.why: Owner 11-09: the Forks zone is THREE arms — 100 m up the Morice, 100 m up the upper Bulkley, ~1 km down the Bulkley (in FWA the water below the confluence is the Bulkley; the Morice ends there). DFO lists the zone twice, once per water, so each place binds its own water's arm and the two together are the zone: this Morice place = the Morice's last 100 m (existing cuts morice_river__bulkley_confluence_u100m → morice_river__bulkley_confluence); the Bulkley place holds the other 2 arms. Replaces the earlier T524 proposal, which wrongly gave this place the 2 Bulkley arms and dropped the Morice.
